object.name: DroneCANUpdate
object.description: Firmware update of one DroneCAN node (an ESC). The ground sets NodeId and ImageSize and Command = Begin: the module sends uavcan.protocol.file.BeginFirmwareUpdate, the node reboots into its bootloader and reads the image back from us 256 bytes at a time; each read is published as DroneCANFileRequest and answered from the DroneCANFileChunk objects the ground writes. State and Offset show progress; a read shorter than 256 bytes ends the update. Abort drops everything. Refused while armed.
